appointments.current_incumbent: Shaktikanta Das (25th Governor, assumed office Dec 12, 2018; granted extensions)
appointments.term: Initial term up to 3 years; eligible for extension (max 5 years per statutory provision)
appointments.appointing_authority: Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC) headed by the Prime Minister

appointments.position: Deputy Governors, Reserve Bank of India
appointments.statutory_limit: Not more than 4 Deputy Governors at any given time (Section 8(1)(a) of RBI Act)
appointments.convention: Conventionally: 2 promoted internally from RBI executive directors, 1 commercial banker, and 1 professional economist
